messages:
Maria: Quick — starting checkpoint conversion for nya-model-v2. Source weights: gs://redwood-models/nyamodel/v2/raw_checkpoint/. Planning safetensors, TP-aware sharding, fp16. Will upload artifacts.

Sanjay: What's the tensor-parallel layout? Trained TP=4 or TP=2?

Maria: Trained TP=4 (Megatron-style). Training produced 16 shards (dp*tp). Target serving shards: 8 (merge DP pairs). Filenames -> nya-v2-00001-of-00008.safetensors ...00008.

Elena: Tokenizer heads-up: original tokenizer uses BOS mapped to id 1 (not 0). convert script must preserve special_tokens_map.json or prompts get off-by-one BOS.

Tim: CR notes:
- preserve kv_cache ordering
- dtype=fp16 unless bf16 requested
- add metadata like "tp_layout":"tp4-shard8","orig_shards":"16"

Sanjay: Paste the exact convert command you're running, I'll validate shard indices.

Maria: running:
```
python tools/convert_state_dict.py \
  --input gs://redwood-models/nyamodel/v2/raw_checkpoint/ \
  --output ./artifacts/nya-v2-safetensors/ \
  --format safetensors \
  --target-shards 8 \
  --dtype fp16
```

Ryan: After conversion run checksum + config-validator. Use tools/validate_package.sh; I added it to CI.

Elena: Also: whitespace merges in tokenizer may cause a couple failing tokenization tests. I can push a tiny patch to special_tokens_map.json or add a post-install fix.

Maria: Conversion finished and uploaded: gs://redwood-models/nyamodel/v2/packaged/nya-v2-safetensors-8/ — CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/convert/1234. deploy-bot: "conversion SUCCESS"

deploy-bot: conversion SUCCESS — artifacts: gs://redwood-models/nyamodel/v2/packaged/nya-v2-safetensors-8/ (32.1 GB)

Sanjay: checksum (leader shard):
```
md5  nya-v2-00001-of-00008.safetensors = 9f2c3a1b6d4e5f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c
md5  nya-v2-00002-of-00008.safetensors = a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9f2c3a1b6d4e5f
```

Ryan: config-validator quick output:
- model_config.json: OK
- tokenizer special tokens: MISMATCH (BOS id)
- tp_layout: detected tp4 -> serving shards 8 mapping OK

Elena: Pushed tokenizer patch (adds explicit "bos_token": "", updates special_tokens_map.json). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/tokenizers/pull/789 — CI passed.

Tim: One more CR comment: when merging DP shards ensure no optimizer/training-only params remain. Otherwise package size + serving errors.

Maria: scrubbed optimizer states and lr_scheduler keys in conversion step — size down ~3GB. Confirmed.

Ryan: Next: Elena to merge tokenizer patch, Tim to approve CR, Sanjay to run inference smoke on a dedicated node (batch=1 seq=2048), Maria will schedule a canary (1 replica) tomorrow.

Sanjay: Running smoke now, will post logs.

Maria: tagging @Tim @Elena @Sanjay for final approvals — will open canary rollout ticket after smoke. :thumbsup:

Tim: Reviewing CR now.

Elena: Patch merged, CI green.

Sanjay: Smoke results: p50=230ms, p95=310ms, outputs match eval prompts, no crashes.

Maria: Rolling canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. Will follow up in morning, thanks!
